subject: Pilot readiness: success criteria & language coverage

From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>

Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-02T15:12:00Z
Subject: Pilot readiness: success criteria & language coverage

Hi Maria — great conversation earlier. Thanks for taking the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a shared starting point for the pilot/POC:

Key priorities you mentioned:
- Customer-facing replies should be within 800ms p95 for short flows (account lookup, transaction status).
- High accuracy on entity extraction for amounts, merchant names, and dispute categories (target: >92% F1 on your sample set).
- Support for English + Spanish (primary) and Portuguese (secondary) for the pilot scope.

Proposed POC scope (4 weeks):
1) Week 0: Kickoff, data checklist & access (sample logs + NER labeling guideline).
2) Week 1: Baseline run on your sample set — evaluate 2 open models and 1 lightweight fallback.
3) Week 2: Tune prompt templates, enable prefix caching & KV config suggestions from Redwood Optimize.
4) Week 3: Stress test for throughput and failover validation (model fallback, region routing).
5) Week 4: Readout + decision: pass/fail against success criteria and recommended next steps.

Model candidates for baseline testing (recommended):
- Primary: Open Llama v3-13B (good multi-lingual performance with Redwood quantized profile)
- Contingency fallback: Falcon-7B-instruct (faster token throughput, smaller memory footprint)
- Safety/guardrail: distilled instruction-tuned variant for template-sensitive responses (to compare hallucination rates)

Ownership & asks from your side:
- Point of contact for dataset transfer and labeling questions: David Huang (david.huang@lumapay.com).
- Legal/Procurement: staged NDA / SOW review — if possible please share contact to loop in procurement.

Attachments: POC-success-criteria.xlsx (simple checklist), redwood-pilot-scope.md (detailed runbook).

Can we lock kickoff for next Monday, 2027-10-04 at 10am PT? If that works I will send calendar invite and the onboarding checklist.

Thanks,
Ava Chen

Thanks Ava — that aligns with what we discussed. A few clarifications: 

1) Language mix: initial sample is roughly 85% English, 12% Spanish, 3% Portuguese. We want the pilot to validate Spanish performance not just English.
2) Success metric nuance: the 92% F1 target is for NER on labeled transaction samples; for end-to-end customer message classification we are comfortable with 88% precision/recall as long as false positives are flagged for human review.
3) Data: we can provide a 2k-row sanitized sample CSV and 200 labeled NER examples in a shared Drive folder.

Kickoff time Monday at 10am PT works for our team. I will ask David to upload the sample data and grant access to your onboarding email.
